headline: Two Indian stocks surge over 200% on US infrastructure demand
hook: US infrastructure demand fuels Indian stock rally
summary: Two Indian companies have seen stock price gains between 205% and 690% due to increased US demand for data centers and pipeline infrastructure. The surge is driven by American capital expenditure in these sectors, which relies on specialized components supplied by these Indian firms. This highlights the growing integration of Indian manufacturing into global infrastructure supply chains.
why_it_matters: Indian industrial firms are benefiting from global infrastructure spending cycles.
winners_losers: Industrial exporters gain / No clear losers
